insertA: Use case: precise-object-edit. Production texture asset for a 3D gift-box animation. Reproject ONLY the fitted dark foam insert and its two products from the reference to a perfectly perpendicular 90-degree top-down orthographic view. Remove the surrounding box walls, lid, SmartGift logo and white studio background entirely. Canvas aspect ratio 1.31:1 landscape. Entire image edge-to-edge is the flat rectangular charcoal foam insert, with generous consistent 8percent foam margin on all sides. Exactly the existing black UD Trucks handled tumbler lying lengthwise top-to-bottom on LEFT, and the same tan True leather card holder on RIGHT, seated in matching fitted dark cavities, retain their exact proportions and original marks. Do not add products or change designs. Crisp photorealistic product texture, fine foam grain, subtle soft diffuse light, restrained baked contact shading, no dramatic cast shadows. Both products fully inside frame, uncropped. All vertical directions parallel; no perspective trapezoid. This is a texture plate, not another shot of the box. No captions or watermarks.
